==Original Dream Journal Entry That Inspired The Episode==
I induced lucidity via sleep paralysis. 

This dream takes place in the same continuity of lucid dreams that started on 06/11/2025 and has continued to the present. These dreams take place in the Storyverse. (The Storyverse is a multiverse where all possible story ideas exist as cosmic bubble universes that float together in a cosmic void.) (My team includes Leon, Johnson, Second Brain, and I.) (My Ghostly UFO, named Leon, resembles a ghostly flying saucer with an ethereal green glow.) (Johnson resembles an orange, humanoid goldfish. He wears a blue astronaut suit but his suit doesn't have a helmet.) (Second Brain is a floating brain made of Lucid Light.) (Lucid Light is a reality warping energy wielded by Lucid Lords. It resembles sparkling purple energy that shines like a night sky full of stars.)

Leon was able to patch Skelebot's vulnerability and repair him.

Skelebot is extremely fast and can run across the Storyverse.

Johnson created Skelebot to be our team's humanoid speedster.
